image_to_video.openingRule: Continue directly from the provided image as frame 0; do not re-stage or restart completed actions.

reference_to_video.openingRule: References guide identity/product/place/style but do not define the literal first frame.

productionRules: Use official one-based IMAGE labels and zero-based AUDIO labels.
Do not mix Start Frame image-to-video with reference-to-video inputs in one request.
For exact Start Frame composition, preserve the source aspect ratio or normalize/crop/pad before submission; do not rely on provider aspect-ratio stretching.
Do not treat attached motion video as a Grok 1.5 reference image; derive motion/camera guidance or route another workflow.
Use external TTS/lip-sync when custom uploaded voice-reference entitlement is unavailable.
